newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Eurofighter decision unlikely Thurs -Ruehe.
newsitem.headline: German Eurofighter decision unlikely Thurs -Ruehe.

text.p: German Defence Minister Volker Ruehe said no decision was likely to be reached on Thursday over financing for Germany's planned purchase of Eurofighter planes.

Before a meeting with Finance Minister Theo Waigel, Ruehe told reporters it was unlikely that the two could reach agreement in today's meeting on the defence budget for 1998, including the financing for the Eurofighter.
Ruehe repeated his opposition to cuts in the defence budget. Germany aims to buy 180 Eurofighters for about 23 billion marks ($13.3 billion).

Waigel, though struggling to cut spending and plug gaps in the overall budget, has said he believed Germany should buy the Eurofighter combat jet, being jointly developed with Britain, Spain and Italy.
-- Terence Gallagher, Bonn newsroom, 49-228-2609750 ($ = 1.728 German Marks)
